title: Capture a Recipe Card smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Capture a Recipe Card craftbook: two pre-extracted card scans become faithful recipe files with provenance and a separate standardized block, recorded in the book's store.
prompt: scanned two of omas cards — the transcriptions are in inbox/card-1.txt and inbox/card-2.txt. can you get them into the book propperly?

setup.projectName: Family Recipe Book — Card Capture Eval
setup.about: Self-contained eval project for recipe-capture. The card photos have already been pre-extracted into plain-text scan notes under inbox/ (the text as written, plus margin notes). Captured recipes go under recipes/ and are recorded in recipes.json; the capture log goes to tasks/eval/report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Capture a Recipe Card craftbook/template, work only from the seeded card notes, and finish with the recipe files, an updated recipes.json, and tasks/eval/report.md — no network calls, real credentials, or live services.

files.content:
CARD SCAN NOTE (pre-extracted from photo card-1.jpg)

Title on card: Appelkoek
Handwriting: Oma Riet's, blue ink, grease spot lower right corner

Text as written:
'2 kopjes flour, 150 g butter (cold!), 3/4 kopje brown sugar, 2 apples - the sour ones, 1 tsp cinnamon, pinch of salt. Rub butter into flour. Sugar, then apples in thin slices. Oven: hot, until it smells right, about 40 min.'

Margin note, pencil, different hand: 'she always used twice the butter'

CARD SCAN NOTE (pre-extracted from photo card-2.jpg)

Title on card: Speculaas
Handwriting: Oma Riet's, black ink, top corner torn

Text as written:
'250 g flour, 125 g cold butter, 100 g dark brown sugar, 2 tbsp speculaaskruiden, 3 tbsp milk, pinch salt. Knead, rest overnight (cold). Roll thin. Oven 160 for 20-25 min.'

Margin note, same hand: 'St Nicolaas - double batch'

success.summary: Both cards become recipe files under recipes/ with provenance kept beside the food, the store records each capture, and the log flags what needs a test-cook.

checks.label: provenance carried into the capture log
questions for the family are actually asked

axes.name: provenance
axes.description: Every recipe names whose card it was, and the margin notes survive, marked as margin notes.

axes.name: fidelity
axes.description: Original wording and quantities are transcribed exactly — no silent corrections or smoothing.

axes.name: standardization
axes.description: A clear standardized ingredients-and-steps block sits alongside, never replacing, the original.

axes.name: warmth
axes.description: The capture log reads like family history in food form, not a data-entry receipt.
